item.title: KubeIt 0.6.0
item.description:
What's New

  • Add log history paging on scroll, "last line received" indicator, and recent-clusters quick reconnect
  • Improve large-cluster performance — memoized sorting, coalesced watch updates, and pre-parsed timestamps cut idle CPU from ~100% to under 10%
  • Add per-cluster memory — reconnects restore last namespace, resource view, sort order, and panel sizes
  • Update log pause/play — pausing freezes the view and resuming no longer duplicates log lines

item.title: KubeIt 0.6.1
item.description:
What's New

  • Prevent log history paging from firing during the initial tail load
  • Snap resource tables to the top when the sort changes so the new order's head rows are visible
  • Defer live watch updates while scrolling — batches apply once the gesture settles, smoothing large-cluster scrolling

item.title: KubeIt 0.6.2
item.description:
What's New

  • Send the pod terminal's real panel size to the pod TTY so editing long commands no longer overwrites text

item.title: KubeIt 0.7.0
item.description:
What's New

  • Name the cluster in pod restart banners, quiet crash-looping pods for 5 minutes, and keep error banners visible
  • Announce every pod restart once, including init and sidecar containers and restarts during a resync or while live updates are paused
  • Keep live updates from staying paused on a list after switching to another kind or cluster
  • Apply the saved sort the first time a resource list opens after a reconnect or restart
  • Sort the pod CPU and Memory columns by value instead of by their display text
  • Keep log text in its original order when the level word is not at the start of the message
  • Use the first level keyword in a log line so INFO lines that mention "error" are no longer shown as errors
  • Show pod CPU of 1 core or more without the "cores" unit so the CPU column reads consistently
  • Add restart notifications with a confirmation when a restart is triggered and a banner when a pod restarts
  • Add favorites for clusters so starred connections sort first on the Welcome screen and in the cluster pickers
  • Add alphabetical ordering for env vars, selectors, and resource requests and limits in the detail panel
  • Add regex search to every list filter via a toggle next to the search box
  • Update the YAML editor to keep indentation on Return, insert spaces for Tab, and stop autocorrect from altering YAML

item.title: KubeIt 0.7.1
item.description:
What's New

  • Load the first resource list after connecting without downloading it twice, and stop re-listing kinds that have no objects
  • Show Pods lists only the pods the workload owns, with a chip to clear the scope
  • Report a failed Secret or ConfigMap save and keep the edits, list only a workload's own pods, refresh details after suspend, restart or scale, and mark OOM-killed and debug containers
  • Show a Ready column for pods, color partly ready rows, and show the status of Jobs including Suspended
  • Stop a slow regular expression in the list filter from freezing the window
  • Show the selected cluster's workloads in XRay after a cluster switch, and never a tree or events from the previous selection
  • Keep rows of the previous kind or namespace out of the list when you switch while it is still loading
  • Compute a CronJob's next execution in UTC like the cluster does, accept @daily and MON-FRI style schedules, and stop yearly schedules stalling the window
  • Record a cluster's context on the main thread when connecting and disconnecting
  • Helm releases reload when you switch clusters instead of showing the previous cluster's list
  • The detail panel closes when its resource is deleted or its tab is closed
  • Connecting a cluster adds it once, and other clusters cannot be clicked while a connect is running
  • Pod terminals stay connected when you switch to another cluster and back
  • Command palette commands (:pod, :ns, :ctx, :help) work, and picking a result opens it from any view
  • Downloading logs reports a failed save and includes lines received while paused
  • Loading older log history no longer repeats lines when the log itself is repetitive
  • Turning off resource names in merged logs also works while timestamps are shown
  • Log lines are shown exactly as written, so search counts and highlights always agree
  • Searching logs no longer crashes when a burst of lines larger than the buffer arrives
  • Resuming paused logs after the pod ended shows the buffered final lines instead of dropping them
  • Workload logs include only the pods the workload owns, not every pod whose name starts the same
  • Log tabs are separate per namespace and cluster, and a reopened workload tab follows its current pods
  • Edit YAML loads the live object, keeps unsaved edits across tab switches, and asks before overwriting a change made on the cluster
  • Prefill the Scale dialog with the desired replica count and reject invalid input
  • Clear a cluster's tables when a load fails or the cluster changes, so data of the previous cluster never stays on screen
  • Keep the workload metrics chart updating after a rollout replaces its pods
  • Select the pod clicked in the Nodes view when it lives in another namespace
  • Check access in the selected namespace, and tell apart denied from could not check in the Access Matrix
  • Keep the cluster list on screen when a connect fails in Add Cluster
  • Never list the same cluster twice, and clear a cluster's port-forwards, log tabs and terminals when it disconnects
  • Keep added kubeconfig files and Max log lines across restarts, show the real read-only state, and remove Preferences that did nothing
  • Count NotReady nodes and evicted or terminating pods correctly on the cluster overview, and show recent events from every namespace
  • Stop listing scaled-to-zero workloads, old ReplicaSets, completed pods and suspended Jobs under Needs Attention
  • Reject port-forward ports outside 1-65535 instead of crashing, and show each forward's real status
  • Announce pod restarts only for the cluster on screen, always name the cluster, and stay quiet about pods that are already crash-looping
  • Add app-side calls for namespace-scoped access checks, owned pods and extra kubeconfig files
  • Watch PersistentVolumeClaims from connect and list a workload's pods by owner
  • One failed port-forward connection no longer shows the whole forward as broken
  • Port-forward traffic counters update while a connection is open
  • Disconnecting a cluster now stops its port-forwards, log streams and terminal sessions
  • A log line with invalid UTF-8 no longer ends a live log stream
  • Resizing a terminal whose shell just exited no longer freezes the app
  • List the pods of a workload by owner reference so similarly named workloads are not mixed up
  • Report a Service only when no pod in its namespace matches its selector
  • Measure resource age when diagnostics run so pods, claims and workloads that stop changing are still reported as stuck
  • Keep reporting an out-of-memory kill after the container has restarted
  • Leave debug containers out of pod readiness so a pod is not flagged as not ready after kubectl debug
  • Count native sidecar containers in pod readiness and restarts, and show 0/N for pods that are not scheduled yet
  • Link a resource to the owner that controls it rather than the first owner listed
  • Report a Job as complete or failed from its conditions, so a Job with completions still to run reads as running
  • Show the phase of PersistentVolumeClaims so a claim stuck in Pending is reported
  • Show DaemonSet readiness from its ready and desired pod counts instead of 0/0
  • Refresh a resource list only when its own kind resyncs, not on every kind's resync
  • Keep cached resources that another watch still covers when a watch stops, and restart a watch whose task has ended
  • Check access in the selected namespace and show failed access checks separately from denials
  • Return an empty list instead of an error when a namespace has no pod metrics
  • Keep pods with a container that has no usage sample, sum CPU without losing sub-millicore precision, and read every memory quantity form
  • Match only the selected node or deployment in Prometheus metric queries
  • Back off between retries when a resource watch keeps failing instead of re-listing in a tight loop
  • Reject a negative replica count and keep pod metric totals from overflowing
  • Run a CronJob manually twice in the same second without a name conflict
  • Show images with an unusual digest in the image inventory instead of crashing
  • Count only new pod restarts in the Pulses restart chart
  • Restart, scale and patch cluster-scoped resources instead of failing with not found
  • Leave read-only mode unchanged when saving the setting fails
  • Keep read-only mode and other settings when the settings file is damaged, and save settings atomically
  • Connect to every context that is listed, including ones from ~/.kube/config when KUBECONFIG is set and from extra kubeconfig files
  • List contexts from the readable kubeconfig files when one file is broken
  • Connect each context only once when two connects for it race
  • Stop one slow or hung cluster request from freezing every other cluster and deadlocking pod metrics
